concerns.text: FR-006 requires validating the proxy assumption by correlating static-log-derived utility with ablation-derived utility. Task T014 generates a 'frequency-weighted' proxy from scratch rather than using the actual static retrieval logs from the original AgenticSTS runs as the proxy input. This creates a circular validation where the proxy is not derived from the static logs as required, leaving FR-006 unimplemented.

FR-001 defines ground-truth utility as the impact on win rate when a layer is removed. Task T008 calculates `utility_delta = baseline_win_rate - ablated_win_rate` but does not include a task to first generate the `baseline_win_rate` (running the 'all-layers' baseline for every trajectory in the training set). Without this baseline generation task, the ablation study cannot compute the required delta, leaving FR-001 unfulfilled.

SC-004 requires measuring 'Token reduction consistency' by calculating the standard deviation of token savings. Task T021 aggregates average win rates and token usage but lacks a specific step to calculate and output the standard deviation of token savings. Task T023 calculates this, but T021 is the primary aggregation task for SC-002/SC-004 data; the gap in T021 means the specific SC-004 metric is not explicitly covered in the main aggregation flow.

SC-002 requires verifying a 30% token reduction. Task T026 exits with code 1 (FAIL) if ANY success criterion is false. This blocks the pipeline from generating statistical evidence (SC-001, SC-003, SC-004) if the 30% target is missed, violating the research goal of producing a report regardless of the outcome. A task to generate the report without blocking on the 30% threshold is missing.

The spec's Assumptions section explicitly requires a specific warning text for n < 300. Task T057a creates a template with a generic placeholder `{{sample_limitation}}` but does not mandate populating it with the specific warning text defined in the spec, leaving the requirement for explicit warning text unenforced in the task description.

The spec's Edge Cases require the system to 'default to retrieving the full all-layers set' when entropy is NaN. Task T059 verifies NaN handling in the entropy module but omits the requirement to verify that the *dynamic selection logic* (T015b) correctly consumes the sentinel to trigger the full retrieval fallback, leaving the end-to-end edge case handling unverified.
